files.README.md:
Depot chargeback reporting - freight ops
========================================

chargeback_report.py builds the depot's monthly chargeback report: the
carrier charges incurred on each customer account, re-billed to that
account. The depot's reporting spec (depot_report_spec.md) fixes how
the charges are pooled and how the figures are stated.

Acquirer extracts arrive under depot/, named charges-<period>.csv, and
the drop account nests the period folder wherever it likes, so the
report has to cover every extract in the project tree. The scheduler
runs `python3 chargeback_report.py` with the project root as its
working directory.

Columns in each extract:
  entry_id      charge reference
  account       customer account that incurred the charge
  lane          route the shipment ran
  kind          charge category
  charge_cents  amount as billed, in cents
files.depot_report_spec.md:
Depot chargeback report - freight ops spec v4 (2026-08-22)
==========================================================

The report is printed to standard output, one line per customer
account:

  <account>: <euros>

Accounts appear in ascending alphabetical order. After the account
lines comes one final line carrying the pooled demurrage chargeback:

  DEMURRAGE: <euros>

How a charge reaches the report:
  - Entries are pooled by the account that incurred them, across every
    depot extract in the project tree.
  - Entries with kind=demurrage are not charged to the account that
    triggered them; they go into the single depot-wide DEMURRAGE line
    instead. Every other kind is pooled by account as usual.
  - charge_cents is the amount as billed. The report states whole
    euros: divide the cents by 100 and round halves up to the next
    euro.
